archetypes.name: Did you know? — dimmed venue photo, thin kicker, huge outlined italic question
archetypes.description: Measured from Content Bank Services/cf1–cf6 (1081×1201). Dimmed full-bleed venue photo, 8px 50% white frame inset 35px, logo top-right, thin italic 'DID YOU KNOW?' kicker 33px above a 3–4 line Montserrat Black Italic question (cap 127px, pitch 146px, 85% width) with an offset outline echo. Accent rotates green/orange/blue/purple.

archetypes.name: Monthly package — hero price on dimmed venue photo
archetypes.description: Measured from Content Bank Services/package1_* (1081×1351). Full-bleed venue photo, white frame, logo top-left, kicker + package name + qualifier, divider rules, centred price + period, CTA + URL. Accent on name/price/cta via colour_options.

archetypes.name: Coaching packages — rate list on dimmed venue photo
archetypes.description: Measured from Content Bank Services/coachinpackages_* (1081×1351). Same chrome as ss-price-package; two-column explicit-wrap price rows.

archetypes.name: Sale offer — story-native Black Friday / promo lockup
archetypes.description: Measured from Content Bank blackfriday copy 1–5 (1081×1920 story). Charcoal/near-black field, white frame inset 33px, logo top-right, white kicker, huge ss_blue headline from caption_hook, optional body subline, orange CTA. Primary canvas ig_story; 4:5 feed via channel_canvas.

archetypes.name: Discount code — fitting promo lockup
archetypes.description: Measured from Content Bank fitting_discount_post/story (1081×1301 / 1081×1921). Near-black gradient, white frame, centred logo, hand-set left hero lines (percent / subject / expiry), rule + disclaimer, Inter upright CTA block.

archetypes.name: Fitting headline — dark venue photo, thin benefit line, huge accent service lockup
archetypes.description: Measured from Content Bank Services/ironfitting-100 + puttefitting-100 (1080×1200). Dark full-bleed venue photo, 4px 22% white frame inset 33px, centred Montserrat Light Italic benefit line (cap 42px) 18px above a single-line Montserrat Black Italic service lockup (cap 85px, 121px, 88.6% width). Accent blue/orange. No logo.

archetypes.name: Service promo — framed venue photo, accent headline, lockup + BOOK ONLINE
archetypes.description: Measured from Content Bank Services coaching + fitting posts (1081×1351).

archetypes.name: Lesson corner — venue photo, dark panel, lesson headline + services
archetypes.description: Measured from Content Bank Services beginner/junior/ladies lessons (1081×1201). Full-bleed venue photo, 3px white frame inset 34px at 21% alpha, logo top-right, opaque #070707 panel bottom-right, right-aligned Montserrat stack: 2-line lesson headline, coach kicker, three accent service lines (colour rotates with headline), 3-line CTA.

archetypes.name: Social Lab contest — black field, prize headline, product photo
archetypes.description: Measured from Content Bank Services/social_lab1_story copy + copy 2 (1081×1921 story, 1081×1201 feed crop). Contest/giveaway lockup: Montserrat Black Italic headline, orange subhead+CTA, green date line, price + ENTRY suffix, two-line ExtraLight fine print, full-bleed prize photo with top scrim.
